correctness.rationale: The two-star facet enumeration is exhaustive. The C++ full Hasse DAG has respectively 202140/1099623/5673835 faces and 1372896/8460504/48937095 covering relations, each completely sorted acyclically, leaving critical cells (1,35,70), (1,70,126), (1,126,210) only in dimensions 0,3,4. A separate Python exact signed Morse reduction computes every one of 70/126/210 critical degree-four boundary columns as zero. Since pi_3 of a wedge of three-spheres is identified by Hurewicz with H_3, all four-cell attaching maps are null and Forman's matching gives the asserted integral homotopy type. Source and outputs embedded; finite experiments are complete for only these three integers.

originality.rationale: Biswas 2026 explicitly proposes rather than proves the all-order two-subset Čech sphere formula and its data stop at order seven. Exhaustive, exact integral homotopy equivalences for the first three uncovered orders are distinct from Jonsson's homology-rank statements and from the indexed general rational top-homology representation theorem; each of those results leaves the new attaching-map splitting undetermined. indexed mathematical-record database, primary-paper and web alias searches found no dominating homotopy theorem, subject to stated access risk.

value.rationale: The first three consecutive orders after the published seven-vertex cutoff constitute a motivated finite frontier for an explicit recent Čech homotopy conjecture. New exact integral homotopy decompositions, proven by exhaustive directed-Hasse matching and integer attaching-map reduction on up to 5.67 million faces, resolve the conjectured homotopy information at all three boundary parameters. This is not a generic all-orders theorem; the large complex and need for integral attaching control make it more than a textbook deduction or tiny numerical improvement.
